subject: Compact QBR + Roadmap demo — condense and reschedule?
body:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@novushealth.com>
Cc: Nina Park <nina.park@novushealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Compact QBR + Roadmap demo — condense and reschedule?

Hi Liam / Nina,

Thanks again for the renewed interest — excited to take Novus through a compact QBR + roadmap demo next week. I know your execs are tight on time, so wanted to propose a condensed 45-minute agenda that still covers:

- Current usage + cost trends (10 min)
- Roadmap highlights & impact areas for Novus (15 min)
- Next steps / mutual action plan (10 min)
- 5 minutes for Q&A + decisions

Proposed slots:
- Tue Dec 7, 10:00–10:45 AM PT
- Wed Dec 8, 2:00–2:45 PM PT

I've attached a compact agenda and a mutual action plan draft. If those are fine I can send a calendar invite and include the technical deep-dive appendix as an add-on for the engineering participants.

Attachments: [QBR-Agenda-compact.pdf (PDF)], [Novus_MutualActionPlan_v2.xlsx (XLSX)]

Best,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0192

----
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@novushealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nina Park <nina.park@novushealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Compact QBR + Roadmap demo — condense and reschedule?

Tessa,

Appreciate the streamlined approach. The execs can do a compact session but only on Dec 8 in the morning (they have a standing board review on the 7th). Can we target Dec 8, 9:00–9:45 AM PT? Also want to include our Head of Data (Nina) and Procurement for a quick pricing/term touch.

One ask: if we can shorten the product rundown to 12 minutes and push some of the detailed performance slides to an appendix, that will keep the execs focused.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
VP Product, Novus Health

----
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:21:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Compact QBR + Roadmap demo — scheduling constraint from Novus

Marissa / Soojin — looping you in so we can confirm who will host and who will do the 12-minute product highlight.

Notes / asks:
- Host (run the meeting, keep time + mutual action plan): who can own?
- Product highlight (12 min): want crisp slides on roadmap wins for healthcare (3 impact bullets + a quick benchmark).
- Technical appendix: include engineering presence if Novus asks for KV cache/latency slides.
- Procurement: I will join but want Tessa to handle the doc send; can Soojin prep a one-slide pricing delta summary?

Proposed internal plan: Marissa takes host, Soojin prepares pricing one-pager, Ben will co-present roadmap. If that works I'll mark availability and send an internal run-through invite (30 min) Dec 7 morning.

-ben
Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Compact QBR + Roadmap demo — scheduling constraint from Novus

Ben / Soojin — I can host. Confirming availability:
- Dec 8, 8:15–9:00 AM PT internal run-through OK for me (quick timing check + slide pass).
- I will own the mutual action plan review and the 5-minute close.

Soojin — if you can drop the pricing delta slide into the shared drive by EOD today, I'll include it in the deck. Ben — please add the 3 roadmap impact bullets to slide 4 and mark any customer-specific callouts.

Runbook pointers I'll cover in the internal dry-run:
- Timekeeping: visible timer on screen; product highlight stops at 12:00.
- Backup: if execs have only 30 min, we pivot to "Top 3 wins + MAP" and drop the appendix.
- Recording: record for Nina's broader org, but stop before procurement-only negotiation.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Customer Success, Redwood Inference

----
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@novushealth.com>, Nina Park <nina.park@novushealth.com>, procurement@novushealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Compact QBR + Roadmap demo — confirm Dec 8 9:00–9:45 AM PT

Liam / Nina / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Dec 8, 9:00–9:45 AM PT is locked on our side. Summary and logistics below:

Agenda (45 min):
- 00:00–12:00 Product & roadmap highlights (Ben + Tessa)
- 12:00–22:00 Usage & cost trends + quick wins (Marissa)
- 22:00–32:00 Mutual action plan and proposed milestones (Marissa + Tessa)
- 32:00–40:00 Procurement touch (Soojin)
- 40:00–45:00 Exec Q&A and decisions

Action items for Novus: please confirm attendee list (we have Liam + Nina + procurement). If Head of Data wants the appendix, we'll keep it ready as a follow-up pack.

Internal owners: Ben (roadmap), Marissa (host & MAP), Soojin (pricing one-pager). I'll send the calendar invite now and attach the compact agenda + MAP.

Attachments: [QBR-Agenda-compact.pdf], [Novus_MutualActionPlan_v2.xlsx]
Calendar: invite sent (Dec 8, 09:00–09:45 AM PT)

Thanks all — looking forward to it. If timing shifts, tell me by EOD tomorrow and we'll re-run availability.

Best,
Tessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Thread notes: internal dry-run scheduled Dec 8 08:15–08:45 AM PT; Ben/Marissa/Soojin/Tessa attending. Pricing one-pager location: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link-qbr-agenda. CRM: see ticket CRM-2211 for deal tasks.]
